info.title: Microsoft 365 Calendar Universal API
info.description: Access Microsoft 365 calendar data through Microsoft Graph, including calendars, events, and calendar views for the signed-in user.

put.description: Accepts an event invitation in Microsoft 365 Calendar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

eventId.description: The ID of the Outlook event to accept.

comment.description: Optional comment to include with the accept response.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Create a new event in Microsoft 365 Calendar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

attendees[].emailAddress.description: Includes the name and SMTP address of the attendee.

attendees[].emailAddress.address.description: The email address of the person or entity.

location.address.description: The street address of the location.

locations[].displayName.description: The name associated with the location.

recurrence.pattern.description:
The frequency of an event.

For access reviews:
Do not specify this property for a one-time access review.
Only interval, dayOfMonth, and type (weekly, absoluteMonthly) properties of recurrencePattern are supported.

subject.description: The text of the event's subject line.

attendees[].emailAddress.name.description: The display name of the person or entity.

attendees[].type.description: The attendee type: required, optional, resource.

body.contentType.description: The type of the content. Possible values are text and html.

importance.description: The importance of the event. The possible values are: low, normal, high.

location.displayName.description: The name associated with the location.

locations[].address.description: The street address of the location.

categories.description: The categories associated with the event.

location.locationEmailAddress.description: Optional email address of the location.

locations[].locationEmailAddress.description: Optional email address of the location.

sensitivity.description: The possible values are: normal, personal, private, confidential.

start.description: The start date, time, and time zone of the event. DateTimeTimeZone

end.description: The end datetime, and time zone of the event. DateTimeTimeZone

showAs.description: The status to show. The possible values are: free, tentative, busy, oof, workingElsewhere, unknown.

isOnlineMeeting.description: True if this event has online meeting information, false otherwise. Default is false. Optional.

onlineMeetingProvider.description: Represents the online meeting service provider. The possible values are teamsForBusiness, skypeForBusiness, and skypeForConsumer. Optional.

isReminderOn.description: Set to true if an alert is set to remind the user of the event.

reminderMinutesBeforeStart.description: The number of minutes before the event start time that the reminder alert occurs.

isAllDay.description: Set to true if the event lasts all day.

hideAttendees.description: When set to true, each attendee only sees themselves in the meeting request and meeting Tracking list. Default is false.

responseRequested.description: Set to true if the sender would like a response when the event is accepted or declined.

allowNewTimeProposals.description: true if attendees can propose new times for this event.

attendees[].description: The collection of attendees for the event.

body.description: The body of the message associated with the event.

recurrence.description: The recurrence pattern for the event.
